name: Read refresh
responsibility: Decides which readings a report makes stale, under every name the tab asked a model by, and in what order
description: Callers report what happened: a model changed, models of a vault were written or let go, a listing may have moved, a vault's policy changed, the socket came back or a person asked for everything again. Reads in flight are cancelled first, so an answer decided before the event never lands as fresh, then a model's document is marked before its pictures, because a picture reads its model the moment it is asked for again. A reading asked by another spelling of the model, or by a name it had before a rename, is read again too.

outgoing.label: every reading the tab holds, and the names it asked by
